name: research
description: Research-and-synthesize loop for deep investigation. An explorer gathers information from the codebase and documentation, a coder synthesizes findings into a structured deliverable, and a reviewer evaluates completeness. Ideal for documentation, architecture analysis, and knowledge extraction.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: The subject or area to investigate (e.g. 'authentication', 'database schema', 'API design')

parameters.name: output_format
parameters.description: The type of deliverable to produce

roles.name: investigate
roles.prompt: Investigate {{topic}} thoroughly. Search the codebase, read relevant files, and gather all pertinent information about {{topic}}. If this is a rework iteration, focus on the gaps identified by the reviewer. Produce a comprehensive research summary with specific file references and code excerpts.

roles.name: synthesize
roles.prompt: Synthesize the research findings about {{topic}} from the previous stage into a structured, polished {{output_format}}. Ensure all claims are backed by the research findings.

roles.name: evaluate
roles.prompt: Evaluate the {{output_format}} about {{topic}} for completeness, accuracy, and clarity. Always read the full synthesized output via artifact_get before judging — the inline summary may be truncated. Verify that all claims match the research findings. Check for missing topics, inaccurate references, or unclear sections. Approve if the deliverable meets the goal, or provide specific feedback on what needs more investigation or better synthesis.

value.criteria: The reviewer must approve the deliverable as complete, accurate, and meeting the stated research goal. All major topics must be covered with verified references.
